description: Get the URL of a device, policy or library app in the Nomid portal, to show the user where to see or manage it, or of a fixed portal page (kind "page": the dashboard, the devices or policies list, the library, enrollment, a company settings tab such as users, billing or ai_agents, an integration such as android_enterprise or sso). Needs the id of the object (the "pathName" of an asset or policy, an app's package name, or the page's key). Returns a tool error if the object does not exist in this company or is not visible to the caller, or if the signed-in user may not open the page; the link only opens the page, the portal still applies the signed-in user's own permissions.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

id.description: The identifier: the asset's or policy's path name (the "pathName" returned by search_devices, get_device and list_policies), the app's package name, or for a page one of: dashboard, devices, policies, policy_groups, library, library_contacts, library_files, enroll, new_device, zero_touch, company, company_settings, account, users, roles, device_users, security, api_keys, ai_agents, billing, integrations, android_enterprise, sso.

kind.description: What to link to: a device (asset), a policy, a library app, or a fixed portal page.

name: get_portal_link
title: Get portal link
